user.title: Smart Panel
user.description: Provision and manage Android wall panels. After setup, open Smart Panels in the sidebar to enter the Wi-Fi details and show the provisioning QR code.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Smart Panel is already set up. It manages every panel from one place.

init.title: Provisioning settings
init.description: New panels join this Wi-Fi network and open Home Assistant at this URL.

data_description.wifi_ssid: The network name (SSID), at most 32 bytes.
data_description.wifi_password: Leave empty to keep the saved password. Not needed for an open network.
data_description.wifi_security: WPA covers WPA, WPA2 and WPA2/WPA3 mixed networks. WPA3-only networks cannot be used for provisioning. NONE is an open network.
data_description.wifi_hidden: Turn on when the network does not broadcast its name.
data_description.ha_url: The address panels use to reach Home Assistant, for example http://192.168.1.10:8123. Panels also report their status here. Use https:// unless the address is on your local network.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// address without a query, fragment or comma.
error.password_required: Enter the Wi-Fi password, or choose NONE for an open network.
error.https_required: Use an https:// address. http:// is only allowed for a local address: a private IP address, localhost, or a .local or .home.arpa name.

user.title: Add panel
user.description: Choose the Home Assistant app registration of the panel. Registrations of the minimal app, which panels run, are marked as likely panels and listed first.

data_description.mobile_app_entry_id: The panel is linked right away and starts reporting its status.

abort.no_candidates: Every Home Assistant app registration is already added as a panel. Provision a new panel first.
abort.already_configured: This registration is already added as a panel.

navigate.name: Navigate
navigate.description: Opens Home Assistant on a panel, freshly loaded, optionally at a path.

path.name: Path
path.description: Path to open, starting with /, for example /lovelace/kitchen. Leave empty for the default dashboard.

factory_reset.name: Factory reset
factory_reset.description: Erases everything on a panel. It has to be provisioned again with the QR code.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be on to erase the panel.

invalid_extra_value.message: The value for {name} cannot contain a comma.

template_in_extra_value.message: The value for {name} cannot contain template syntax.

panel_not_registered.message: The Home Assistant app registration of {panel} is not loaded.

panel_not_reachable.message: Could not send the command to {panel}: Home Assistant has no notification target for its app registration ({error}). Either the registration is not connected for push notifications, or another app registration has the same device name; give each device a unique name in the Companion app.

send_failed.message: Could not send the command to {panel}: {error}

invalid_brightness.message: Brightness must be a whole number from 0 to 255.

brightness_unknown.message: The panel has not reported a brightness, so there is no value to keep.

factory_reset_not_confirmed.message: Confirm the factory reset to erase the panel.

screen_off_disabled.message: Screen off is disabled until Home Assistant issue 176371 is fixed: turning the screen off makes the panel stop receiving commands. See {url}

device_not_found.message: Device {device_id} is not a Smart Panel.

release_lookup_failed.message: Could not look up the latest panel app release: {error}
